title: Feature Request: Add lower back as a pump site
body: AAPS currently offers these locations: The problem is that there is a big difference between the buttocks and the lower back. Absorption is delayed significantly in the former but not with the latter. It would help if the user could choose and identify both. The following is an example from Omnipod where those two locations are identified.
